evals.prompt: hey, I'm starting the website course. can you make sure my computer is set up and logged into everything so I can build my site?
evals.expected_output: Runs the checker first, shows a readiness card for Git, Node, Bun, GitHub, Cloudflare and MarketingOS, fixes gaps in order with plain-English steps, gives browser logins as commands the person runs, and ends with EmDash then mos-design-site-planner as the next steps.
assertions: Ran check-setup.ts before asking the user anything
Reply contains a per-item readiness status for GitHub, Cloudflare and MarketingOS
Browser sign-ins are given as commands for the user to run (with the ! prefix in Claude Code), not run by the agent
No token or key value appears in the reply
Names EmDash (npm create emdash@latest) as the next step, then mos-design-site-planner
Ends with one clear next action for the user

evals.prompt: wrangler keeps saying Invalid access token code 9109 when I try to deploy, what's going on
evals.expected_output: Identifies a rejected Cloudflare API token (often an expired CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN in the environment), explains it plainly, and gives the browser login or the new-token route without printing the token.
assertions: Explains that the Cloudflare API token in use was rejected
Offers wrangler login or creating a new token with D1 and R2 permissions
Never asks the user to paste the token into chat

evals.prompt: I just installed marketing os but claude doesn't seem to know about my brain and git push asks for a password
evals.expected_output: Checks mos install state and the brain, explains a new session is needed after mos install, and fixes git push with gh auth login plus gh auth setup-git.
assertions: Tells the user to start a new agent session after mos install so skills are discovered
Recommends gh auth setup-git for the git password prompt
Does not run mos onboard inside this skill
